**2024 in film** is an overview of events, including the highest-grossing films, award ceremonies, critics' lists of the best films of 2024, festivals, a list of country-specific lists of films released, and movie programming. [Columbia Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbia_Pictures "Columbia Pictures") and [Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer "Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer") (MGM) celebrated their [100th anniversaries](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centennial "Centennial"); [Toei Company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toei_Company "Toei Company") celebrated its 75th anniversary; [DreamWorks Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DreamWorks_Pictures "DreamWorks Pictures") and [DreamWorks Animation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DreamWorks_Animation "DreamWorks Animation") celebrated their 30th anniversaries; and the first [Mickey Mouse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mickey_Mouse "Mickey Mouse") films, including _[Steamboat Willie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamboat_Willie "Steamboat Willie")_ (1928), entered the [public domain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_domain "Public domain") this year. Three of the films, _[Inside Out 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out_2 "Inside Out 2")_ , _[Deadpool& Wolverine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deadpool_&_Wolverine "Deadpool & Wolverine")_, and _[Moana 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moana_2 "Moana 2")_ made $1 billion in 2024.
Alongside new releases, multiple popular films like _[The Lion King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Lion_King "The Lion King")_ (1994), _[Les Misérables](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Les_Mis%C3%A9rables_\(2012_film\) "Les Misérables \(2012 film\)")_ (2012), _[Alien](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alien_\(film\) "Alien \(film\)")_ (1979), _[Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_I_%E2%80%93_The_Phantom_Menace "Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace")_ (1999), _[The Mummy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Mummy_\(1999_film\) "The Mummy \(1999 film\)")_ (1999 film), _[Whiplash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whiplash_\(2014_film\) "Whiplash \(2014 film\)")_ (2014), _[The Texas Chain Saw Massacre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Texas_Chain_Saw_Massacre "The Texas Chain Saw Massacre")_ (1974), _[Shrek 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shrek_2 "Shrek 2")_ (2004), _[Twister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twister_\(1996_film\) "Twister \(1996 film\)")_ (1996), _[Saw](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saw_\(film\) "Saw \(film\)")_ (2004), _[Coraline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coraline_\(film\) "Coraline \(film\)")_ (2009), _[The Nightmare Before Christmas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Nightmare_Before_Christmas "The Nightmare Before Christmas")_ (1993), _[Hocus Pocus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hocus_Pocus_\(1993_film\) "Hocus Pocus \(1993 film\)")_ (1993), _[Interstellar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interstellar_\(film\) "Interstellar \(film\)")_ (2014), and _[Tenet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tenet "Tenet")_ (2020) were re-released to either celebrate their anniversaries and/or fill in the gaps left by films that had their original release dates affected by the [2023 Hollywood labor disputes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Hollywood_labor_disputes "2023 Hollywood labor disputes"). These disputes, including the [Writers Guild of America strike](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Writers_Guild_of_America_strike "2023 Writers Guild of America strike") and [SAG-AFTRA strike](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_SAG-AFTRA_strike "2023 SAG-AFTRA strike"), had a significant impact on the 2024 release schedule, with many films being postponed due to productions being halted mid-filming or before commencement.

### Box office records
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2024_in_film&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Box office records")]
  * _[Inside Out 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out_2 "Inside Out 2")_ surpassed _[The Lion King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Lion_King_\(2019_film\) "The Lion King \(2019 film\)")_ to become the [highest-grossing animated film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_animated_films "List of highest-grossing animated films") of all time and became the [8th highest grossing film of all time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_films "List of highest-grossing films") upon its release.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-3)
    * _Inside Out 2_ became the 54th film to gross $1 billion worldwide[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-4) and the 12th animated film to do so.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-ootw-5)
    * It became the fastest animated film to gross $1 billion worldwide.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-ootw-5)
    * The [_Inside Out_ film series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out_\(franchise\) "Inside Out \(franchise\)") grossed over $2.5 billion with the release of _Inside Out 2_.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]
  * _[Deadpool& Wolverine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deadpool_&_Wolverine "Deadpool & Wolverine")_ became the 55th film to gross $1 billion worldwide. 
    * It had the highest-grossing opening weekend ever for an R-rated film.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-dwall-6)
    * It surpassed _[Joker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joker_\(2019_film\) "Joker \(2019 film\)")_ (2019) as the highest-grossing R-rated film of all time.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-dwall-6)
    * It is the eleventh MCU film to gross over $1 billion, and the first since _[Spider-Man: No Way Home](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spider-Man:_No_Way_Home "Spider-Man: No Way Home")_ (2021).[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]
    * It is the second R-rated film to gross over $1 billion, and the first since _[Joker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joker_\(2019_film\) "Joker \(2019 film\)")_ (2019).[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-7)
    * The [Marvel Cinematic Universe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marvel_Cinematic_Universe "Marvel Cinematic Universe") became the first [film franchise](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Film_franchise "Film franchise") to gross $30[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-dwall-6) and $31 billion[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-8) with the release of _Deadpool & Wolverine_.
  * _[Moana 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moana_2 "Moana 2")_ became the 56th film[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-PeopleDM-9) and the 13th animated film to gross $1 billion worldwide.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]
    * The _[Moana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moana_\(franchise\) "Moana \(franchise\)")_ film series grossed over $1.5 billion with the release of _Moana 2_.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]
  * The _[Despicable Me](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Despicable_Me "Despicable Me")_ film franchise became the first animated film series to gross $5 billion with the release of _[Despicable Me 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Despicable_Me_4 "Despicable Me 4")_.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-PeopleDM-9)
  * _[Wicked](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicked_\(2024_film\) "Wicked \(2024 film\)")_ , the first installment in the [musical's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicked_\(musical\) "Wicked \(musical\)") [two-part adaptation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicked_\(film_franchise\) "Wicked \(film franchise\)"), became the highest-grossing film based on a work set in the [Land of Oz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Land_of_Oz "Land of Oz").[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]
    * It became the first musical film to gross over $164 million worldwide on its opening weekend, making it the highest opening worldwide gross for a film based on a stage musical since _[Les Misérables](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Les_Mis%C3%A9rables_\(2012_film\) "Les Misérables \(2012 film\)")_ (2012).[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-11)
    * It surpassed _[Mamma Mia!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mamma_Mia!_\(film\) "Mamma Mia! \(film\)")_ (2008) as the highest-grossing Broadway musical film adaptation of all time.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-Billboard-12)

  * _[Inside Out 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out_2 "Inside Out 2")_ became the highest-grossing [Pixar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pixar "Pixar") film of all time, surpassing _[Incredibles 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incredibles_2 "Incredibles 2")_ (2018).[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-20)
    * With the release of _Inside Out 2_ , Pixar became the first animation studio to produce five films that grossed $1 billion.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-21)
  * _[Deadpool& Wolverine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deadpool_&_Wolverine "Deadpool & Wolverine")_ became the highest-grossing R-rated [Disney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walt_Disney_Studios_\(division\) "Walt Disney Studios \(division\)") film, surpassing the 34-year-old record set by _[Pretty Woman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pretty_Woman "Pretty Woman")_ in 1990.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-DeadlineOpenWknd-22)


### Other records
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2024_in_film&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Other records")]
  * _[Deadpool& Wolverine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deadpool_&_Wolverine "Deadpool & Wolverine")_ became the most viewed trailer of all time until being surpassed by _[Spider-Man: Brand New Day](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spider-Man:_Brand_New_Day "Spider-Man: Brand New Day")_ (2026).[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-23)
  * _[Wicked](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicked_\(2024_film\) "Wicked \(2024 film\)")_ became the best PG-rated first-day ticket pre-seller of the year and the number 3 best PG-rated first-day ticket pre-seller of all time, behind _[Frozen 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frozen_2 "Frozen 2")_ and _[The Lion King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Lion_King_\(2019_film\) "The Lion King \(2019 film\)")_ (both 2019).[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-24)
  * _[Terrifier 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terrifier_3 "Terrifier 3")_ became the highest-grossing unrated film of all time.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-25)
  * 2024 is the first year since [2019](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_in_film "2019 in film") in which the top ten highest-grossing films worldwide were entirely Hollywood productions.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film#cite_note-BOM2024-1)
